prompt:
Animate this lineup of ten game enemies as ONE looping walk cycle, all ten at the same time, each walking in place. The camera is fixed and does not move, zoom or pan. Left and right in this description are the screen's left and right. Forward is screen right: every character faces screen right and walks toward screen right, but stays exactly where it stands in the image, inside its own cell, like a walk on a treadmill: its body never travels across the picture, never drifts sideways, never moves into another character's space, and the ten never touch or overlap. Every character keeps its own size, the small ones stay small and the huge ones stay huge.
Every beat, for each character: the body stays near-side-view facing screen right with the head looking forward; the feet touch one and the same ground line as in the image and the body rises and sinks a little with each step; every character keeps the same pace of one full step cycle and keeps the same height above the ground line in every frame.
Each character walks in its own way. The biped characters (the Spark Imp, the Cinder Goblin, the Ash Cultist, the Salamander Warrior, the Obsidian Golem, the Blaze Duelist, the Lava Ogre) alternate their legs: the near leg lifts and swings forward toward screen right while the far leg pushes back toward screen left, the knees bend, and the arms swing in opposition to the legs; the heavy ones (the Obsidian Golem and the Lava Ogre) take slow, short, heavy steps and the light ones (the Spark Imp and the Blaze Duelist) take quick light steps. Each biped that holds a weapon keeps it in the same hand, hanging low and swaying with the step, and never raises it; the Cinder Goblin keeps its torch low, the Ash Cultist keeps its censer low, the Salamander Warrior keeps its axe low, the Blaze Duelist keeps both blades low, the Lava Ogre keeps its anvil hammer low. The Salamander Warrior's tail sways gently from side to side behind it. The Ember Hound and the Flame Drake walk on four legs: the legs move in alternating diagonal pairs, the head and the tail sway with the steps, and the Flame Drake keeps its wings folded against its back. The Magma Slime has no legs and does not travel: its dome pulses, bulging and squashing in a steady rhythm as if it were crawling, and its drips ripple at the bottom.
The clip ends in exactly the pose it starts in, so the walk loops. Every character keeps its own design, colours and outline exactly as in the image; the flames, the cracks and the glow stay on its own body and never drift to another character; no character has a tail except the Ember Hound, the Salamander Warrior and the Flame Drake.
The flat solid pure magenta background stays unchanged and fixed in every frame: no scenery, no ground, no shadows, no extra effects, no text, no grid, no camera shake.
